name: k31-dark-store
prompt:
Inside a quick-commerce dark store at night: narrow aisles of steel racks lit by cool white LED strips, a picker in a company T-shirt (plain, no lettering) pulling solid-colour snack packets and Mango Drink packs from a shelf into a crate, a handheld scanner on his belt, a MUNCHLY carton open on the shelf. Medium shot, 35 mm, cool light, shallow depth of field.

Photorealistic cinematic film still, live action, 35 mm, eye level, shallow depth of field, natural light, real skin and fabric. The cartons are kraft-brown with a sage-green band and the word MUNCHLY printed once in bold dark-green capital letters on each carton's side, nothing else written on them; the snack packets are solid orange, green and red with no lettering; the Mango Drink packs are small plain yellow-orange tetra packs with a mango drawn on them and no lettering. No other text, letters, numbers, logos or watermarks anywhere. No number plate. No children.
use: SC-187 cut 2 keyframe: the first frame of a Veo clip for the demo film; the app's own screen on the phone
